rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that motivates people, especially a story, film, or speech.

example.english: This film is truly inspirational; after watching it, I immediately wanted to pull myself together.
example.traditional: 呢套戲真係好勵志，睇完我即刻想重新振作。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 lai6 zi3 tai2 jyun4 ngo5 zik1 hak1 soeng2 cung4 san1 zan3 zok3

rows.note: Use this when the thing is inspirational because it gives people ideas or insight, especially a book, talk, or discussion.

example.english: This book is very inspirational and gave me new ideas about raising children.
example.traditional: 呢本書好有啟發性，令我對教仔有新諗法。
example.jyutping: nei1 bun2 syu1 hou2 jau5 kai2 faat3 sing3 ling6 ngo5 deoi3 gaau3 zai2 jau5 san1 nam2 faat3

rows.note: Use this for an uplifting, emotionally stirring effect, especially in more formal descriptions.

example.english: They gave an inspirational speech at the ceremony.
example.traditional: 佢喺典禮上發表咗一篇鼓舞人心嘅演講。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 din2 lai5 soeng6 faat3 biu2 zo2 jat1 pin1 gu2 mou5 jan4 sam1 ge3 jin2 gong2
